lesson: The reply contained tool-call markup instead of C source, so nothing compiled and the FLAGS line was empty. The attempt also wasted turns on repeated, pointless shell probes like whoami, date and echo. Next time, answer directly with one fenced C block holding a complete matmul. Use a cache-blocked, register-tiled kernel with an i-k-j inner loop, write every C element, and handle any n with remainder loops. Follow it with a line such as "FLAGS: -O3 -march=native -ffast-math".
